Common stuff

The mic doesn't pick up my voice.

Open Settings → VoCal and make sure Microphone and Speech Recognition are both on. Then quit and relaunch the app. If you're on a beta build, try the latest TestFlight version.

It logged the wrong meal.

Tap the meal, then Edit. You can fix the name, macros, or delete it entirely. We use your corrections to improve the model.

How do I cancel my subscription?

Settings → Apple ID → Subscriptions → VoCal Pro → Cancel. Apple handles the billing — we never see your card.

How do I delete my account?

In the app: Profile → Privacy → Delete account. All your data is wiped within 30 days. Or email us and we'll do it for you.

Restaurant menu is missing something.

Tap the meal after logging, edit the macros, and send a quick note. We pull menus from official chain sources and PDFs — if it's a seasonal or regional item, it might not be indexed yet.

Beta testers

On TestFlight? Use the Send Beta Feedback screen recording → it lands directly on our dashboard. Or email us with steps to reproduce.
